summary: Lewis Hamilton faces Ferrari's wrath this weekend in Austin as Kimi Antonelli arrives needing just points to clinch the championship after Hamilton's Singapore blunder handed the Ferrari driver a commanding lead. McLaren's pursuit of the constructors' crown adds another layer of intrigue, with the team fighting to capitalize on Ferrari's momentum shift and Hamilton's strategic misstep. A victory for Antonelli would end the title fight two races early and mark a stunning coronation for the young Ferrari driver, while any Hamilton redemption would keep the drama alive heading into Mexico City.
